scope: One elementary cellular automaton transition at a three-bit neighbourhood, plus fixed-zero row boundaries.
vector_encoding: ASCII decimal rule,left,center,right:output followed by LF for all 2048 vectors
limitations: A mathematical reference does not establish refinement of production JavaScript.
Lean and GNATprove checks require real locally executed pinned tools.
Finite matching vectors are evidence of bounded agreement, not universal correctness.
Locally generated reports and self-hashes cannot authenticate their executor.
